title: #atlas-eng: Rate limiting PR in review — load test results

messages.author: sarah-chen
messages.text: PR #48 (rate limiting) is ready for final review. Load test results: handles 1200 req/min per tenant cleanly. Returns 429 with correct Retry-After header. @alex-kumar @morgan-park can you take a look today?

messages.author: alex-kumar
messages.text: On it. Quick note: I noticed in staging the 429 response doesn't have a user-visible error state yet. Is Figma updated for this? Might want to make sure design covers the error toast before we ship.

messages.author: sarah-chen
messages.text: Good point. I'll check with the design team — I don't think the Figma file has a 429 state yet. Will follow up.

title: #atlas-eng: Billing refactor load test — EU replica lag warning

messages.author: jordan-lee
messages.text: Billing refactor load test running at 5x peak traffic. US region looks great. BUT: EU read replica is showing 800ms lag at peak. Probably fine for now since we're not EU-primary yet, but worth watching. I'll mention it in the weekly sync.

messages.author: alex-kumar
messages.text: 800ms replica lag sounds like a connection pool or query planner issue. Could bite us hard if we expand EU. Should we file a ticket to investigate?

messages.author: jordan-lee
messages.text: Yeah probably. Low priority for now though — we're not routing EU reads through that replica yet. I'll bring it up in standup and see if anyone wants to own it.

title: #atlas-lumen-sync: Auth v2 still blocked — escalating timeline

messages.author: sarah-chen
messages.text: Pinging again on LMNE-22 / auth v2. We're now 5 weeks from the June 15 v1 sunset. Atlas still can't merge PR #49 until Lumen deploys v2. Can we get a firm date?

messages.author: priya-nair
messages.text: PR #31 is in code review right now. PM signed off on scopes schema Friday. Targeting merge Monday or Tuesday next week (May 18-19). You should be able to pick it up immediately after.

messages.author: sarah-chen
messages.text: Ok — marking ATLS-55 as 'waiting on Lumen deploy May 18'. Premium feature flags (ATLS-56/PR #57) unblocks immediately after. Fingers crossed.

title: #atlas-eng: HMAC webhook timing bug discovered in load test

messages.author: sarah-chen
messages.text: Caught a bug during load test: Stripe webhooks using Date.now() for HMAC timestamp window, but under load the clock drift causes valid signatures to be rejected. Switching to a monotonic clock. Filed as ATLS-47, PR #54 up.

messages.author: alex-kumar
messages.text: Good catch. This would have caused silent billing failures in production under traffic spike. Reviewing now.
